description.zh:
开启加速链路，订阅加速功能公测中，基于调度策略与网络链路优化，
可提升镜像订阅速度
description.en: Indicates whether an acceleration link is enabled for image subscription. The subscription acceleration feature is in public preview. The feature is optimized based on scheduling policies and network links to accelerate image subscription.
The name of the Container Registry namespace.
Indicates whether the original image is overwritten.

description.zh:
操作系统/架构，当源端仓库中为多架构镜像时，只将指定的操作系统/架构
订阅到企业版实例的目标仓库
description.en: The operating system and architecture. If the source repository contains a multi-arch image, only the specified operating system and architecture are subscribed to the destination repository of the Enterprise Edition instance. Subscribe to the destination repository of an Enterprise Edition instance
The name of the Container Registry repository.

description.zh: 源端命名空间，当 `SourceProvider` 为 `DOCKER_HUB` 时有默认值 `library`，其他场景必填

description.en:
The source of the artifact.

Valid values:

*   DOCKER_HUB: Docker Hub
*   GCR: GCR
*   QUAY: Quay.io

description.zh: 订阅源端仓库镜像版本, 支持正则表达式
description.en: The image tag in the subscription source repository. Regular expressions are supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr create-artifact-subscription-rule --instance-id cri-c0o11woew0k0000 --source-provider DOCKER_HUB --source-namespace-name library --source-repo-name nginx --namespace-name test-ns --repo-name test-repo --tag-regexp release-v.0 --tag-count 1 --override true --accelerate true --platform 0/0 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr CreateArtifactSubscriptionRule --region cn-hangzhou --Platform.1 '0/0' --NamespaceName 'test-ns' --TagCount 1 --SourceRepoName nginx --InstanceId 'cri-c0o11woew0k0000' --TagRegexp 'release-v.0' --RepoName 'test-repo' --SourceProvider DOCKER_HUB --Accelerate true --SourceNamespaceName library --Override true
